problem.problem:
Dave is quiet. Fiona is big. Fiona is furry. Gary is round. Gary is young. Harry is quiet. Harry is rough. If someone is furry then they are rough. Big people are rough. If someone is rough then they are young. If someone is young and round then they are quiet. Big, young people are cold. Cold people are round. If someone is young and not furry then they are not round.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Dave is not big.
raw_logic_programs:
Predicates:
Quiet($x, bool) ::: Is x quiet?
Big($x, bool) ::: Is x big?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Cold($x, bool) ::: Is x cold?

Facts:
Quiet(Dave, True) ::: Dave is quiet.
Big(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is big.
Furry(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is furry.
Round(Gary, True) ::: Gary is round.
Young(Gary, True) ::: Gary is young.
Quiet(Harry, True) ::: Harry is quiet.
Rough(Harry, True) ::: Harry is rough.

Rules:
Furry($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: If someone is furry then they are rough.
Big($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: Big people are rough.
Rough($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: If someone is rough then they are young.
Young($x, True) && Round($x, True) >>> Quiet($x, True) ::: If someone is young and round then they are quiet.
Big($x, True) && Young($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: Big, young people are cold.
Cold($x, True) >>> Round($x, True) ::: Cold people are round.
Young($x, True) && Furry($x, False) >>> Round($x, False) ::: If someone is young and not furry then they are not round.

Query:
Big(Dave, False) ::: Dave is not big.
